title: Rookidee care package Cobblemon
description: This datapack for Cobblemon revamps Rookidee's shiny texture and adds a variety of unique costumes to customize its appearance.
body:
#  **Rookidee Care Package** #  

Made by **Flyingcarrots**

This is a Cobblemon cosmetics addon for Rookidee, adding more cosmetic styles and a refreshed default shiny texture, giving you new ways to customize your Rookidee.

📦 **Installation**

Place the ```.zip``` file into both your datapacks and resourcepacks folders to activate the pack.

🎨 **Pokémon Cosmetics Included**

You can apply cosmetics using either the required item or commands:


```
/pokegive rookidee aspect=<style>
```

Monocle Style Rookidee
Tinted Glass → aspect=monocle

Sunglasses Style Rookidee
Glass block → aspect=sunglasses

White Style Rookidee
White Wool → aspect=white

Witch Style Rookidee
Purple Wool → aspect=witch

Brain Style Rookidee
Pink Wool → aspect=brain

Bunny Style Rookidee
Rabbit Foot → aspect=bunny

Egg Style Rookidee
Egg → aspect=egg

Flower Style Rookidee
Any flower (Dandelion, Poppy, Blue Orchid, Allium, Azure Bluet, Tulips, Daisy, Sunflower, Lilac, Rose Bush, Peony, Cornflower)
→ aspect=flower

Graduation Style Rookidee
Black Wool → aspect=graduation

A small cosmetic pack designed to give Rookidee more personality, charm, and customization options while keeping its original Cobblemon feel.
